source: docs/dataset-spec.md §2, EGY positive check and MSA Egyptian-syntax lint
notes: markers: the spec list «مش، عايز/عاوز، ده/دي، إزاي/ازاي، إمتى، فين، دلوقتي، بكرة، كده، اللي، بتاع، فيه، كمان، ليه، لسه، خالص» with «عايزة/عايزه» (spec: both accepted); «عاوزة/عاوزه» are the same feminine forms of «عاوز».
prefix_markers: matched as a word start, so «بتاعي» counts as «بتاع».

verb_prefixes + imperfect_letters: the spec's «هـ+verb» and «بـ+verb», detected as ه/ب + an imperfect prefix letter in a word of at least verb_min_length letters. This is a heuristic: in EGY/CS it is a weak marker (warning when it is the only one); in MSA only «هأ» is an error, ه + ت/ي/ن is a warning and بـ+verb is not checked (MSA «بتاريخ»).
msa_warning_only: markers that are also plain MSA («فيه» = in it), reported as warnings in the MSA column.
